description: Feature 3.7 Phase 3 claim audit across all documentation

prediction_probability_mislabels.description: Calling prediction output a probability or likelihood
prediction_probability_mislabels.note: API doc uses 'popularity score (0-100)' throughout; no probability language

regression_accuracy_mislabels.description: Using classification accuracy language for regression metrics
regression_accuracy_mislabels.note: All references to MAE/RMSE/R² use correct regression terminology

causal_shap_claims.note: API doc §8: 'do NOT establish causal relationships'; USER_MANUAL §6: 'do NOT prove causation'

causal_what_if_claims.description: What-if described as proving real-world causal effects
causal_what_if_claims.note: API doc §9: 'does NOT prove that changing...will causally increase'; USER_MANUAL §7: 'NOT a causal relationship'

guaranteed_success_claims.description: Prediction described as guarantee of commercial/popularity success
guaranteed_success_claims.note: USER_MANUAL §5: 'NOT a guarantee of commercial success'

unsupported_production_claims.note: README and USER_MANUAL explicitly state 'student research prototype' and 'academic'

unsupported_global_dataset_claims.description: Dashboard described as representing all global music (instead of 'available dataset shows')
unsupported_global_dataset_claims.note: USER_MANUAL §8: 'The available dataset shows 1922-2019 data from a curated Spotify-derived sample. It is not a comprehensive representation of all music globally.'

unsupported_accuracy_claims.description: Fabricated accuracy percentages or 'high accuracy' claims
unsupported_accuracy_claims.note: No accuracy percentage claims anywhere; performance described only as 'test set metrics' with actual MAE/RMSE/R² labels

offline_live_equivalence.description: Offline mode described as live inference or equivalent to full model
offline_live_equivalence.note: Both docs: 'precomputed validated fallback — not live model inference'
